26" Beach Cruiser Bike with Shimano 7-Speed & Fat Tires
Welcome to the Micargi Slugo 26" Beach Cruiser Bike! Known for its great design and performance, this bike is the perfect choice. Let's take a closer look at its specs:
Whether you're cruising the beach or driving the city streets, the Micargi Slugo 26" Beach Cruiser Bike gives you a ride like no other. Its steel frame and triple tree fork ensure a solid structure and a stable ride, while the tall handlebar and comfortable-feeling seatpost provide an ergonomic riding position for a more comfortable ride.
7-speed disc brakes: Equipped with Shimano 7-speed disc brakes, this bike provides excellent braking performance, and the appropriate gear can be selected according to road conditions and riding intensity, making riding more comfortable and efficient. Such as climbing, downhill, flat road, etc., to provide a better riding experience. Ensure safety on all terrains.
26*4.0 FAT Tire:ompared with ordinary tires, the three-piece alloy crank and wide FAT tire have a larger airbag volume, which can provide better cushioning effect, reduce the feeling of road vibration when riding, and improve riding comfort. Especially on uneven roads or bumpy mountain riding, fat tires can better absorb the impact, and when passing through some complex road conditions, such as sandy beaches, muddy fields, snow fields, etc., they have better passing performance. The low pressure of the fat tire allows the tire to step on soft soil or loose ground better, increasing traction and reducing slippage. The width and low pressure of the fat tires allow the bike to have a lower center of gravity, increasing the stability of the bike and reducing the risk of rolls and crashes.
Whether you're commuting in the city or cruising for fun, the Micargi Slugo 26" Beach Cruiser Bike is your perfect ride. Grab yours today and enjoy the ride!
